key_highlights: ASX set to open higher, following a Wall Street rally spurred by easing inflation concerns from a softer US jobs report.
Recent RBA rate hikes are significantly impacting the domestic housing market, with auction clearance rates dropping and mortgage stress surging.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East (Iran war) are driving profitability in the Australian gas sector.
Major data centre investments face community and regulatory pushback amid floats and multibillion-dollar projects.
ANZ ceases its audit relationship with KPMG amidst broader challenges for the accounting firm, including seeking a $100m global loan.

sectors.trend: Bullish momentum driven by Middle East geopolitical escalation (Iran conflict) boosting global gas and LNG prices.
sectors.implications: Positive revenue revisions likely for major ASX-listed gas producers (e.g., Woodside, Santos).

sectors.trend: Pressure on retail banking and professional services; surging mortgage stress from RBA hikes and corporate shuffling (ANZ dropping KPMG).
sectors.implications: Banks may face rising bad debts and slower credit growth; increased scrutiny on audit and advisory partners.

sectors.trend: Continued exploration and speculative interest in mid-tier/junior miners, specifically copper, rare earths, and silver.
sectors.implications: Potential opportunities in junior resource stocks despite broader macroeconomic headwinds.

sectors.trend: Significant cooling in residential property markets, especially mid-sized capitals, driven by RBA rate hikes and plunging auction clearance rates.
sectors.implications: Headwinds for residential developers and consumer-facing retail exposed to mortgage stress.

sectors.trend: Massive capital inflows into data centres ($32b hyperscale, Firmus float) facing increasing ESG, community, and transparency backlash.
sectors.implications: High growth potential but escalating regulatory and execution risks for tech infrastructure plays.

key_themes: RBA Rate Hike Fallout: Mortgage stress and housing market cooling
Geopolitical Tailwinds for Energy: Iran conflict enriching local gas producers
Macroeconomic Deterioration: Rising unemployment, sticky inflation, and AUD weakness
Data Centre Boom and Backlash: Surging infrastructure investment meeting community resistance

risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from domestic cyclical stocks and consumer discretionary; increase exposure to offshore earners.
Underweight residential developers and highly leveraged retail banks; favour commercial or industrial REITs.
Maintain a hedge via energy (LNG producers) and traditional safe-haven assets (gold miners).

opportunities.rationale: Australian gas industry is directly benefiting from supply concerns linked to the Iran conflict.
Ongoing speculative interest and discovery success in copper, silver, and rare earths.

defensive_moves.rationale: Surging mortgage stress, RBA rate hikes, and rising unemployment will severely impact household spending and increase bank bad debts.

market_outlook.short_term: Positive start to the week expected following Wall Street's lead, but domestic gains will be capped by the reality of RBA rate hikes, soaring mortgage stress, and a weakening AUD.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious outlook. The Australian economy faces structural headwinds from rising unemployment, sticky inflation, and housing market corrections. Demographic shifts ('Boomer exit') will further reshape capital flows.
key_catalysts: Subsequent RBA rate decisions and commentary
Escalation or de-escalation of the Iran conflict and its impact on energy markets
Domestic employment and inflation data releases
Regulatory approvals for multibillion-dollar data centre projects
watch_list: Auction clearance rates in mid-sized capitals
Global LNG and Brent Crude prices
US inflation and Federal Reserve rate expectations
